sources.title: Emotional Attachments in Abusive Relationships: A Test of Traumatic Bonding Theory

concepts.definition: A strong attachment to an abusive person built by cycles of harm and kindness.

questions.q: Which two conditions did Dutton and Painter (1993) name?
questions.a: A power imbalance and an intermittent pattern of abuse and good treatment.

questions.q: Why is a safety plan important?
questions.a: The period around leaving can carry the highest risk, and professionals can help to reduce it.
